title: Mixing Makes Markovian Contexts Cheap for Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2603.12530v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work shows that when contexts are drawn i.i.d., linear contextual bandits can be reduced to single-context linear bandits. This ``contexts are cheap'' perspective is highly advantageous, as it allows for sharper finite-time analyses and leverages mature techniques from the linear bandit literature, such as those for misspecification and adversarial corruption. However, this reduction crucially relies on the independence of contexts and does not extend to settings with temporally correlated (e.g., Markovian) contexts, which arise frequently in practice. Motivated by applications with temporally correlated availability, we extend this perspective to linear bandits with Markovian context processes, where the action set evolves via an exogenous Markov chain. Our main contribution is a reduction that applies under uniform geometric ergodicity. We construct a stationary surrogate action set to solve the problem using a standard line

translated_title: 混合性使马尔可夫上下文在线性老虎机中变得廉价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.12530v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：近期研究表明，当上下文是独立同分布抽取时，线性上下文老虎机问题可以归约为单上下文的线性老虎机问题。这种“上下文是廉价的”视角极具优势，因为它支持更精细的有限时间分析，并能借助线性老虎机文献中的成熟技术，例如处理模型误设和对抗性污染的技术。然而，这一归约关键地依赖于上下文的独立性，无法扩展到上下文具有时间相关性（如马尔可夫性）的情形，而这种情况在实践中频繁出现。受上下文以时间相关方式出现的应用所启发，我们将这一视角扩展到具有马尔可夫上下文过程的线性老虎机问题，其中动作集通过一个外生马尔可夫链进行演化。我们的主要贡献是一个在一致几何遍历性条件下成立的归约。我们构造了一个平稳的替代动作集，从而能够使用标准的线性老虎机……
tldr: 该论文将“上下文廉价”归约扩展到马尔可夫上下文过程的线性老虎机问题，证明在一致几何遍历性（混合性）条件下，可通过构造平稳替代动作集并使用标准线性老虎机算法求解时间相关的上下文问题。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the "contexts are cheap" reduction to linear bandits with Markovian context processes, showing that under uniform geometric ergodicity (mixing), the problem can be solved by constructing a stationary surrogate action set and applying standard linear bandit algorithms.
